zones.name: A Block
zones.description: Five-storey academic block. Career Management Cell, 1st floor (NIET NAAC SSR, 2017).

zones.name: B Block
zones.description: Academic block with the auditorium (1st-2nd floor) and Students' Welfare (NAAC SSR, 2017).

zones.name: E Block
zones.description: Academic block; reading room on the 1st floor (NAAC SSR, 2017).

zones.name: Pharmacy Block
zones.description: Pharmacy department and laboratories. Restricted lab areas.

zones.name: Men's Hostel
zones.description: Boys' residence on the old campus.

zones.name: Women's Hostel
zones.description: Girls' residence on the old campus.

zones.name: Playground
zones.description: Main playground with a basketball court.

zones.name: Food court
zones.description: Food outlet near the south-west lane (Mother Dairy point mapped in OpenStreetMap).

zones.name: New Campus Block
zones.description: Academic building on Plot 14. Unnamed in OpenStreetMap; student reviews describe first-year teaching on the new campus.

approximateZones.name: Health Centre (C Block)
approximateZones.description: NIET's report places the health centre (full-time doctor and nurse) on the C Block ground floor. C Block is not in OpenStreetMap, so this position is an assumption to confirm with the campus.

gates.name: Old Campus Main Gate
gates.description: The only vehicle gate of Plot 19 mapped in OpenStreetMap; marked wheelchair accessible.

gates.name: New Campus Gate
gates.description: Plot 14 entrance from the IILM Road side; marked wheelchair accessible.

approximateGates.name: West Corner Emergency Entrance (to survey)
approximateGates.description: Only one vehicle gate to Plot 19 is mapped, so a blocked main gate cuts the old campus off. The plot meets the same public ring road again at its west corner; modelled here as a closed candidate emergency entrance so rehearsals can test it. Confirm on site before relying on it.

hospitals.name: Yatharth Hospital
hospitals.description: Multi-specialty hospital with an NIET tie-up (NAAC SSR, 2017). Road distances from OSRM.

hospitals.name: Kailash Hospital
hospitals.description: Multi-specialty hospital near Pari Chowk with an NIET tie-up (NAAC SSR, 2017). Road distances from OSRM.
